fidelity_issues.message: Depth 71 studs is the current constructive baseline and remains refinable.
Openings and detailed components are deferred; this module establishes the principal masonry mass.
Supported 5404 skin starts at Z141 and ridge top is Z164; both remain refinable against the Z140/Z162 architectural datums.
Roof length follows the current 71-stud constructive depth baseline plus one-stud longitudinal overhangs.
The five base photos do not expose the exact upper-run step count. Mission 054 constrains its constructive rhythm from the observed lower-run family without claiming an exact photographic metric.
No local depth change is introduced at the floor boundary without positive photographic evidence; the exterior masonry face remains coplanar.
Human feedback reports a small interior recess, but current photographs do not establish its geometry. Mission 052 intentionally adds no recess geometry.
051 rebuilds MODULE003 from the validated two-run circulation and first-class major void. Envelope and major-void topology are high confidence; local metrics and fine interfaces remain refinable.
VOID_01 is architecturally established as a large ground-open negative space with an upper boundary. Its exact metric depth remains refinable.
The future timber terrace is not built in MODULE003; only the high-level interface remains reserved.
Known viewer-opening UX debt is recorded but intentionally not addressed in mission 051.
MODULE004 footprint and exact railing spacing are coarse constructive approximations preserving the observed relations, not photo-measured dimensions.
Only observed support structure is represented. Hidden additional supports remain unknown and are not promoted to photographic truth.
Diagonal braces are visible in the base photos but are not approximated with orthogonal blocks because the current engine lacks an honest diagonal beam primitive.
MODULE003 and MODULE004 are adjacent high-level systems. Their exact physical connection is not observable and remains unencoded.
